items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: he played some record that when he was with Les Hite's band, and Lionel was playing the vibes... I thought about what he said about Lionel

ctx.x: But when he says, Randy, I'm going to play a record for you. This was down at New Orleans, and he played some record that when he was with Les Hite's band, and Lionel was playing the vibes. And he says, now, you're going to have to listen real hard to hear this, he says, because of the fact, he says, I kept him back. He says, I wish I had let him play out. This is what he told me, now. I'm getting these words from Louis. Now, it's no one can dispute this because the man is dead, but if the man was living, he and…
